scope.description: Complete declared Canon constituent: the five proper Communicantes paragraphs and two separately printed proper Hanc igitur paragraphs, their five Infra actionem headings, five governing usage rubrics and two Sequitur cues selected from the fully inspected preface section printed pp. 175–200; then the standalone CANON MISSÆ title (FIDES 0263), facing Crucifixion (0264), and all text under the body CANON MISSÆ heading on printed p. 203 through the final sung Per ómnia sæcula sæculórum, ℟. Amen. and adjacent Iungit manus on p. 213, stopping before Orémus. The proper forms occur on printed pp. 176, 177, 181, 183 and 184 and precede the main Canon in original source order. Every intervening preface text outside these selected blocks is excluded. The final cutoff is the stated Canon-proper boundary; the book continues the Canon Missæ running head over the following Pater. This is a complete declared constituent and partial whole-book coverage.
omitted_book_divisions: All front matter, calendar, general rubrics and earlier Ordo Missæ outside the named Canon selection

All preface chants, preface bodies and preface rubrics except the five named Infra actionem headings, seven proper Canon paragraphs, five governing usage rubrics and two Sequitur cues on printed pp. 176, 177, 181, 183 and 184
The Orémus/Pater introduction beginning on printed p. 213 and all subsequent material, including pages still bearing the running head Canon Missæ
The entire Temporale, Sanctorale, Commons, votive and other proper formularies and all other book divisions outside the declared constituent
